casting_anchor.scope: Casting palm; source has no separate staff object/bone
casting_anchor.coordinate_scope: Original FBX Y-up axes; Unreal importer converts scene axes. Runtime canonical point should be read from imported reference skeleton, not copied unconverted.

playback_contract: Runtime uses normalized authoritative phases, variable rates and hold/blend overlays; reference durations never gate attacks or motion.
unreal_bone_name_rule: Unreal FBX importer sanitizes dots to underscores, as verified in the existing NutTankImport report. Native lookups must accept root.x/root_x etc.
